description: Re-read a source you previously paid for, FREE, using the held Citation License — no second payment. Held licences are SHORT-LIVED (typically an hour from purchase); `expiresAt` on the original pay tells you when. This also covers a source inside a SCOPE licence you bought up front: pass the url and any live licence whose scope covers that path is used. If the license is holder-of-key bound, a fresh wallet proof-of-possession is signed automatically. Returns ok:false with a `reason` when no live licence covers it: buy it with naulon_pay_and_read, which also checks held licences first. Any locally-cached copy of earlier content is your own continuity only; it carries no live license and must never be cited as a paid read.

format.description: `markdown` (default) returns the article itself, without the page around it. `html` returns the page exactly as the site served it.

slug.description: Source slug you previously paid for with naulon_pay_and_read.

url.description: The exact url this source was paid at. Pass it whenever you have it — a held licence is matched against the ISSUER derived from this url, so a url on a different host than the one that minted the licence will MISS. Required to use a SCOPE licence, whose coverage is decided by path and which is therefore filed under no single slug. Never pass a proofUrl or recordUrl here; those are naulon's hosts, not the publisher's.

name: naulon_read_held

article.description: What the article is: title, byline, date, canonical URL, word count, approximate tokens.

extraction.description: How `content` was produced. `gate`: the publisher's gate extracted the article and the licence hash covers exactly this text. `passthrough`: the site served markdown itself. `client`: this client extracted it from the HTML after delivery, so the licence hash covers the HTML, not this text. `raw`: no article could be extracted and `content` is the page as served. Absent for format html.

proofUrl.description: CITE THIS beside the source — the same proof page the original pay returned. When you quote this source word for word, append `#quote=` and the quoted words, percent-encoded, and the page checks the quote too.

reason.description: Why the free re-read did not happen. `expired` — you held it, its window closed. `not_matched` — you hold a licence for this slug but it was not matched (usually the url's host differs from the issuer that minted it; retry with the exact paid url). `never_held` — nothing for this source. `refused_by_publisher` — the licence was presented and the publisher's site rejected it, which may be a fault on THEIR side, not yours. `site_unreachable`: you hold access to this page and the site did not answer; nothing was spent, try again later. `page_not_found`: you hold access but the site has no such page; nothing was spent, and retrying will not help.

recordUrl.description: The gate's permanent citation record for the settlement behind this licence.

terms.description: The RSL usage terms this payment executed — WHAT YOU MAY DO with the content.

usage.description: The grant in one sentence, derived from the licence. THIS IS THE AUTHORITY on what you may do with the content — do not substitute a stricter guess of your own.

title: Re-read a source you already licensed (free)
